title: Algeria Drought Index SPEI (TerraClimate), 1961–2025: national, wilaya and commune
title_fr: Indice de sécheresse SPEI pour l'Algérie (TerraClimate)
description: Standardised Precipitation–Evapotranspiration Index at 1, 3, 6 and 12 months, monthly 1961-01 to 2025-12, for Algeria, its 69 wilayas and 1,541 communes, plus SPEI-3 and SPEI-12 maps at 1/30°. Computed by AEO from TerraClimate precipitation and Penman–Monteith reference evapotranspiration, calibrated on 1991–2020.
purpose: Monitor meteorological and agricultural drought in Algeria, including the effect of evaporative demand that rainfall-only indices miss.

provider.name: Climatology Lab, University of California Merced / University of Idaho (TerraClimate); Algeria Earth Observatory (SPEI computation)

creator: Algeria Earth Observatory maintainers (SPEI computation); Abatzoglou et al. (TerraClimate)
license_notes: TerraClimate is released under CC0 (public domain). AEO SPEI outputs are CC BY 4.0: cite AEO, TerraClimate and the SPEI method.

Algeria Drought Index SPEI (TerraClimate), version 1.0.0. https://algeria-earth-observatory.github.io/data/aeo-dza-spei-terraclimate/ — from Abatzoglou, J.T. et al. (2018), TerraClimate, Sci Data 5, 170191, doi:10.1038/sdata.2017.191; method: Vicente-Serrano, S.M. et al. (2010), J. Climate 23, 1696–1718, doi:10.1175/2009JCLI2909.1.

spatial_extent.description: Algeria (AEO boundaries 2026-11-20): 1 country, 69 wilayas, 1,541 communes; maps at 1/30°.

temporal_extent.description: Monthly 1961-01 to 2025-12; updated yearly when TerraClimate adds a year. Calibration 1991–2020.

resolution.spatial: 1/30° (≈3.7 km) maps; statistics per administrative unit

variables.name: spei_1, spei_3, spei_6, spei_12
variables.description: SPEI for 1-, 3-, 6- and 12-month water balances (standard normal; ≤ −1 dry, ≤ −1.5 severe, ≤ −2 extreme)

variables.name: p_mm, pet_mm, d_mm
variables.description: Area-weighted precipitation, reference evapotranspiration and water balance P − PET

variables.name: hyper_arid
variables.description: Normal annual precipitation 1991–2020 below 100 mm: SPEI reflects evaporative-demand anomalies only

processing: TerraClimate monthly P and PET read over OPeNDAP for the Algeria window; QC; area-weighted unit means with nested commune weights; SPEI on unit water balances (log-logistic, unbiased PWM, fitted per calendar month on 1991–2020, clipped at ±3.09); grid SPEI-3/12 for maps; exports with SHA-256 manifest. Method: /docs/method-spei/.
validation: SPEI code reproduces the R package SPEI 1.8.1 to 1e-13 (synthetic series; differences only beyond the ±3.09 clip). Automated tests: standardisation over 1991–2020 (mean ≈ 0, sd ≈ 1 for every wilaya and scale), completeness, water balance = P − PET, checksums. No independent comparison with Algerian station-based indices yet.
limitations: TerraClimate is an interpolated climate product (WorldClim climatology + reanalysis anomalies); station density in Algeria is low, especially in the south.
In hyper-arid areas (normal P < 100 mm/year: much of the Sahara) SPEI is driven by evaporative demand only and does not indicate water-supply drought; these units are flagged and masked on maps.
With a fixed 1991–2020 calibration and rising evaporative demand, recent years tend to be drier and early decades wetter: SPEI includes the warming signal by design.
The national SPEI is dominated by the large Saharan wilayas and is not representative of the agricultural north; use wilaya or commune series.

algeria_notes: For rainfed cereals, SPEI-3 at the end of winter and spring and SPEI-6 for the agricultural year are the most informative; SPEI-12 summarises annual water balance and multi-year droughts such as 2020–2024.
